name: Swift Feet
tagline: Get on your feet and dance!
blurb: A high energy and up-beat action program, Swift Feet encourages children to be active.
description: A high energy and up-beat action program, Swift Feet encourages children to be active. 20 different exercises and 10 different dances set to music take users through high, moderate and low impact movements. This activity was designed for OLPC Canada in collaboration with ParticipACTION Canada and Ophea.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
